posts.title: The Agentic AI Super Cycle
posts.summary:
AI is the biggest revolution of our lives, and it will grow exponentially into the 2030s.
The post The Agentic AI Super Cycle appeared first on Semiconductor Engineering.
bullets: The industry is transitioning from generative AI to 'Agentic AI,' which is projected to have a significantly higher economic impact by automating cognitive labor.
Data center AI capital expenditure is forecast to surge from approximately $1 trillion this year to between $3 trillion and $4 trillion by 2030.
Despite calls for pacing model development for safety, investment remains aggressive, with AI infrastructure now accounting for over half of U.S. GDP growth.

posts.title: Reducing Contact Resistance Pushes 2D Transistors Toward Advanced CMOS (HUST, PolyU, UCSB, NUS)
posts.summary:
Researchers at Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Hong Kong Polytechnic University, University of California, Santa Barbara, and National University of Singapore published a technical paper titled “Low contact resistance and high current density in ballistic p-type transistors based on oxygen-doped WSe2 monolayers.” Abstract Excerpt: “The development of high-performance p-type monolayer transistors is critical for... » read more
The post Reducing Contact Resistance Pushes 2D Transistors Toward Advanced CMOS (HUST, PolyU, UCSB, NUS) appeared first on Semiconductor Engineering.
bullets: A multi-university research team has demonstrated high-performance ballistic p-type monolayer WSe2 transistors using oxygen p-doping.
The breakthrough addresses the critical issue of high contact resistance and metal-induced gap states (MIGS) that have historically hindered 2D semiconductor performance.
This development is a significant step toward integrating 2D materials into sub-1nm CMOS nodes, potentially offering a viable alternative to traditional silicon.

posts.title: Extreme Environments Push Chips To Their Breaking Point
posts.summary:
Orbital data centers, defense systems, quantum computing, particle physics, and advanced manufacturing are raising the bar for simulation, test, and lab tools.
The post Extreme Environments Push Chips To Their Breaking Point appeared first on Semiconductor Engineering.
bullets: The rise of orbital data centers and advanced defense systems is driving a surge in demand for radiation-hardened chip designs at advanced process nodes.
Designers are increasingly forced to qualify chips against multiple simultaneous stressors, including thermal shock, vibration, and cryogenic temperatures.
New initiatives like the DARPA-funded 'Rads to Watts' program are exploring the use of radioisotopes to provide long-term, high-density power for electronics in extreme environments.

posts.title: Connecting AI agents to enterprise knowledge
posts.summary: For all the data that AI systems continually amass and analyze, enterprise AI agents often suffer from a curious shortcoming: a lack of knowledge. More than data, knowledge is the understanding of what the data means in the context of individual organizations. AI agents need this understanding to reason about situations, make decisions, and ultimately…
bullets: Only 34% of enterprise agentic AI projects successfully reach production, with data fragmentation and lack of contextual knowledge identified as primary failure points.
Organizations classified as 'production leaders' achieve a 61% success rate by prioritizing semantic knowledge and robust data integration.
Effective agentic AI requires more than raw data; it necessitates a structural foundation that provides agents with semantic, episodic, and procedural understanding of organizational context.

posts.title: Bringing predictive analytics to the agentic AI era
posts.summary: In 2026, the question for enterprise AI is no longer whether predictive models can outperform statistical forecasts—that argument is settled. The big question now is how to enable predictive systems to act on their own conclusions without drifting from business intent. The frontier has moved from prediction to autonomous decision making, and the gap between…
bullets: Enterprise focus has shifted from static statistical forecasting to autonomous decision-making systems powered by real-time generative AI.
Modern predictive engines are increasingly utilizing unstructured data sources, moving beyond traditional numerical records to capture complex business interactions.
The integration of deep learning allows for continuous model evolution, enabling organizations to transition from passive hindsight to active, pragmatic foresight.
